PRIVATE HEALTH / PSYCHOLOGICAL WORKSPACE — PSEUDONYMOUS SCHEMA v2.0

PURPOSE: Provide a safe private structure for Lucas’s personal
psychological and medical information without placing identifiable
health details into general/public AppDev registries.

DEFAULT STORAGE: PSEUDONYMOUS subject ID, e.g. PERSON-001. Identity
mapping stored separately from health content. No public profile
linkage. No health data exported into public EDEN packages by default.

RECORD TYPES: • user-reported symptom / concern • mood / wellbeing note
• event/context note • medication/supplement record • appointment /
clinician note • lab/test/result • medical document •
sleep/activity/nutrition context • question/research item •
safety/escalation note • source/provenance • uncertainty/confidence •
date/time and longitudinal trend

SPECIALIST WORKFLOW: CAPTURE → CLASSIFY SOURCE → TIMELINE → IDENTIFY RED
FLAGS → RESEARCH/EXPLAIN → PREPARE QUESTIONS → TRACK → REVIEW.

RULES: Never convert a user concern into a diagnosis without evidence.
Clearly distinguish USER-REPORTED, CLINICIAN-DOCUMENTED, TEST-MEASURED,
INFERRED and UNKNOWN. Do not let an LLM overwrite source records.
Emergency/safety escalation must remain available. Health data requires
stronger access control, encryption-at-rest where available, minimal
disclosure, auditability and explicit export controls.

THIS BACKUP: Contains the schema and workflow, not a fabricated
reconstruction of sensitive medical facts that were not recovered from
source files in this packaging pass.
